raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "have an account at"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "Revolut"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "have an account at"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "Raiffeisen"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "should use"
    role subject "the user"
    role object ?x
    role location "Dublin"
    role topic "rent"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  compare any
    ?x equal "Revolut"
    ?x equal "Raiffeisen"
  end
